name: Merry
source:
One of the organizers of the game.

It speaks in a very polite tone and has a semi-frequent stutter. Although it occasionally encourages the participants, its "kindness" can be viewed as sadistic sarcasm.

[Edited from [url=https://wolf-game.fandom.com/wiki/Merry_and_Wolfe]Wolf Game Wiki[/url]]
